network.num_nodes: <int> Total number of nodes in the network, including both junctions and centroids.
network.num_links: <int> Total number of directed links in the network, including road links and centroid connectors.
network.num_junctions: <int> Number of junction nodes representing road intersections.
network.num_centroids: <int> Number of centroid nodes representing zones where travelers originate, arrive, and vehicles park.
network.grid_rows: <int> Number of rows in the rectangular grid of junction nodes.
network.grid_cols: <int> Number of columns in the rectangular grid of junction nodes.

nodes.type: <str> Whether this node is a 'junction' (road intersection) or a 'centroid' (traveler origin/destination zone).

links.id: <int> Unique identifier for the directed link.
links.from: <str> Node identifier at the upstream (tail) end of the link.
links.to: <str> Node identifier at the downstream (head) end of the link.
links.type: <str> Whether this link is a 'road' between junctions or a 'centroid_connector' linking a centroid to the road network.
links.length_ft: <int> Physical length of the link in feet.
links.free_flow_speed_mph: <int> Speed at which vehicles traverse the link under uncongested conditions, in miles per hour.
links.capacity_vph: <int> Maximum flow rate of vehicles that can enter or exit the link per hour.
links.free_flow_travel_time_steps: <int> Number of time steps required to traverse the link at free-flow speed.
links.congested_wave_speed_mph: <int> Speed at which a congestion wave propagates backward along the link, in miles per hour.
links.congested_travel_time_steps: <int> Number of time steps for a congestion wave to traverse the full link length.
links.jam_density_vehicles: <float> Maximum number of vehicles that can physically occupy the link at standstill.

time_parameters.time_horizon_T: <int> Total number of discrete time steps in the analysis period.
time_parameters.time_step_duration_seconds: <int> Duration of each time step in seconds.
time_parameters.demand_period_steps: <int> Number of time steps during which new traveler demand arises.
time_parameters.demand_period_duration_minutes: <float> Duration of the demand arrival period in minutes.

demand.scenario: <str> Label describing the spatial pattern of demand across origin-destination pairs.
demand.demand_percentage: <float> Scaling factor applied to the base demand level.
demand.total_travelers: <int> Total number of person-trips across all origin-destination pairs.

od_pairs.origin: <str> Centroid identifier where travelers in this group begin their trip.
od_pairs.destination: <str> Centroid identifier where travelers in this group wish to arrive.
od_pairs.num_travelers: <int> Number of travelers wishing to travel from this origin to this destination.
od_pairs.departure_times: <list[int], length num_travelers> Time step at which each individual traveler wishes to depart from the origin centroid.

fleet.total_fleet_size: <int> Total number of shared autonomous vehicles available in the system.
fleet.fleet_rule: <str> Rule used to determine the fleet size relative to total demand.
fleet.initial_distribution: <dict, key: '{centroid_id}'> Number of vehicles initially parked at each centroid at the start of the analysis.
